g.text: 1 "Events On/Off" toggle over the cost chart (default On when the session has events; hidden when it has none). Kept in the URL with the other chart params.
2 Event markers: one diamond per surfaced event at its event time; hover shows time, event, key attributes, agent; click scrolls to the row below.
3 Session events list: filter chips per kind, newest last, first 9 rows + "Show N more". Live: rows arrive through the existing since= delta; new rows get the usual highlight.
4 Mid-turn prompts and classifier verdicts never show prompt text; for a team-no-prompts caller the Details column reads "hidden for your role" (DD-22).
5 Hook overhead: Log Hub's own hook marked "ours"; unmatched user / plugin hooks grouped as "Other hooks (N)". How "ours" is recognised is an open question.
Older Claude Code / old hook: no events → no markers, no toggle, Session events card hidden; the rest of the tab is unchanged.
